answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a unique optical lattice clock transition fingerprint, so a sybil must replicate physically unclonable frequency standards rather than merely copy keys. Like timber grain, lotus vein, and juniper bark patterns, each clock's drift signature is irreproducible, and peers attest only identities whose measured Allan deviation. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
